headline: Rwanda Unveils Investment Model to Expand Private Clean Energy Financing
summary: The Rwandan government launched a renewable energy financing strategy, shifting from project-by-project grants toward an investment framework designed to attract private institutional capital.
why: Rwanda is expanding power generation capacity across East Africa to support industrialization and regional grid integration.

impacts.name: Rwanda
impacts.why: Mobilizing private capital accelerates clean energy infrastructure buildout.
